sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: whisper-small: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-small is a 244-million-parameter multilingual speech recognition and translation model developed by openai. Built as a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture, it was trained on 680,000 hours of labeled speech data using large-scale weak supervision and demonstrates strong generalization across datasets and domains without fine-tuning.
